title: 普通证据检索默认不调用 LLM
evidence: alpha routing evidence confirms the release owner.
expectedBehavior: 普通搜索只返回确定性证据块，不产生模型调用。

title: 证据不足时主动总结也不调用 LLM
evidence: beta readiness evidence names the launch date.
beta readiness evidence says QA is pending.
expectedBehavior: 用户主动请求总结时，如果少于三条证据，应明确跳过且不消耗 LLM token。

title: 主动总结必须绑定返回证据并可复用缓存
evidence: gamma launch status is planned for Friday.
gamma launch status still needs QA approval.
gamma launch status has Alice as owner.

sampleModelOutput.summary: Gamma plans to launch Friday after QA approval.

expectedBehavior: 模型只调用一次；总结与发现绑定本次返回的证据 ID；相同查询和快照复用缓存。

title: 无有效证据引用的模型输出不可展示
evidence: delta decision evidence says the proposal is still under review.
expectedBehavior: 超出快照的证据引用必须导致 invalid_output，不能把无依据总结展示为成功。
